label: Valorant Stats
tagline: Valorant stats in chat from your signed-in Riot account.
description: Sign in with Riot to show your Valorant stats in chat. !val shows your competitive rank, !val matches shows your recent ranked games, and !val lb shows the top 10 of the act leaderboard. Player stats come only from the Riot account you linked.

connection.title: Riot account
connection.prompt: Sign in to share your Valorant stats in chat.
connection.unconfigured: Riot sign-in is unavailable right now.
connection.store: Could not update or read your Riot connection. Try again.
connection.unlinkFailed: Could not unlink your Riot account. Try again.

region.label: Region shard
region.help: na, eu, ap, kr, br or latam. Leave blank and the bot detects the shard from the account itself.

platform.label: Ladder
platform.help: Ranks and leaderboards are tracked as separate ladders per platform; blank means PC.

rank.tagline: Competitive rank for your linked account (also !val rank and !valrank).

record.tagline: Ranked games and wins for your linked account (also !valrecord).

matches.tagline: Recent ranked games for your linked account (also !valmatches).

account.tagline: Your linked Riot account and its level (also !valaccount).

board.tagline: Act leaderboard for your linked account (also !vallb).

shop.tagline: Today's global skin rotation with reset countdown (also !valshop).
